issue: जहँ अपवित्र सकल दुःख हरिहैं (Drik Panchang हरिहौं): the half has no subject, and it is unclear whether the demon Visphoṭaka is still speaking (he begins at chaupāī 15) or the Mother's promise begins; chaupāī 17 continues in the future and chaupāī 18 ends 'the Lord spoke this true word'.
our reading: The demon goes on speaking: where there is impurity, all its sorrow will be taken away (हरिहैं, an unnamed subject).
alternatives: With Drik Panchang's हरिहौं: 'where there is impurity I will take away (afflict?)'; or chaupāīs 16b–17 as the Lord's promise, named in chaupāī 18.

issue: शेढ़ला महला रुणलीह्युणनी मंदला: folk names of Śītalā; रुणलीह्युणनी is unclear (perhaps two names run together, e.g. Ruṇakī-Jhuṇakī).
alternatives: रुणकी-झुणकी or another pair of names.

issue: पुरी तिवारी मोर निवासा: whether पुरी तिवारी is a place (a village or quarter) or 'I, a Tivārī, (of the) town'.
our reading: Purī Tivārī is my home, at Kakarā on the bank of the Gaṅgā, by Durvāsā's hermitage.
alternatives: 'I am a Tivārī; my home is the town (purī) of Kakarā'.

issue: अब विलम्ब मैं तोहि पुकारत: विलम्ब ('delay') has no verb.
our reading: Now it grows late; I call to you.
alternatives: 'Now (make no) delay; I call to you'.

issue: पड़ा क्षर तव आस लगाई: क्षर ('the perishable') is odd; the book and Drik Panchang both print it.
our reading: This perishable one lies here with his hope set on you.
alternatives: पड़ा द्वार, 'lying at your door' (a likely slip).
